# `bs`

**Version:** 0.1.0

- **Usage:** `bs [--config <CONFIG>] [--json] <SUBCOMMAND>`

## Global Flags
- **`--config <CONFIG>`** — Override the XDG configuration file
- **`--json`** — Emit a single JSON document (no prompts)

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
- **`-V --version`** — Print version
